next.reason: 1985: 'In the Report Section data-name-1 need not appear in a data description entry.' The 2023 report group description entry format brackets the entry-name clause ('level-number [ entry-name-clause ]', §2023:13.15.2), and when it is absent 'the word FILLER is assumed' (§2023:13.18.20.3 SR2). An unnamed report entry is accepted and means the same (it cannot be referenced in either edition); no exception condition.
